title: Cule marih maybalaalaqa
intro: Qaxmaqaaneey, hawweenit kee inki amri ammirtima qandet marrooweh yan caylale mirac muucisa. ta muuci fayyale reeda essera, qibaadah astooti soonoona, kee baddi fanah garuq sinni kattat amrise. ellecabo oggol catoonuh kaxxam udurrutteh gufteh tan kaxxiini amriik ilaa baxsimte lee fan gexa gexo kattaata.
clues: Anu qigdu cayla liyooh, Israa-eel xaylo inni xintoh gubat naqoosa abe.
Anu innih fayyale degelti kinnim yiysixxigeeh, yok dagal yan rabbih mamaxxaga acayuh cineh.
Anu Hamaan amriseh fayyale kalqata yoh xisam too Anu Muusa Yalla ablem duudah.
Anu Muusa kee Harun qado astooti baahen wak garayeeh, ken miracles sorcery exce.
Anu Muusaa kee muuminiin inni qande lih bar bar bad guffa haanam fan kattaate.
Anu baddi addat cule wak imaan yeybeleeleqeh, takkay immay kaxxam raageh sugeeh, yi dagar astah innal daccarsimeh suge.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Xamca kee amaan le girat qideenih sugen
Mango sanootah kataysis lih gablah addat xiine
Adda xexxaaral kaxxa kullumti yanxuqeh suge
Muusaa kee Israa-eel xaylo baxsime badih addat kattaatak sugen wak kak raden
trial.answer: Muusaa kee Israa-eel xaylo baxsime badih addat kattaatak sugen wak kak raden

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Qafuuta kee xer salaamah reeda yomcowwe
Kufrit cultem kee xagar daccarsimeh too sarra
outcome.answer: Kufrit cultem kee dagar daccarsimeh too sarra

arabic: ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verse: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters? (10:91)
